title: Count Tested Devices After Test Operations
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array batteryPercentages of length n, representing the battery percentages of n devices, increment the count of tested devices for each device with a positive battery percentage.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array batteryPercentages of length n, representing the battery percentages of n devices, increment the count of tested devices for each device with a positive battery percentage. For each tested device, decrease the battery percentage of all subsequent devices by 1, ensuring their battery percentage does not fall below 0. Return the total count of tested devices.
constraints: Process devices from left to right.
When the current effective battery is positive, test it and reduce every later positive battery by one.
Return the number of devices tested.
hints: Every earlier successful test subtracts exactly one from the current device.
Thus effective charge equals its stored value minus the number already tested.
Increment the tested count exactly when that difference is positive.
This scalar count represents all prior decrements, making explicit mutation of every suffix unnecessary.

tests.explanation: Devices zero, two, and four remain positive when reached, so three are tested.
The first is skipped; the other two are tested, producing two.
